The row still states that the prefix cache is off for this mode, so the benchmark keeps avoiding the T-041 SSD prefix-cache at-rest and TTFT surface. The supplied patch excerpt is truncated and head ranges mention lines 1145-1146, which I could not see. The visible base text for lines 1-846 contains no behavior changes and no security-control edits. The new flags are described only in docs; their implementation (BenchmarkCommand, RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark) is not supplied. I could not check whether concurrent or staggered benchmarking touches the coordinator, attestation, keys or the cache. Based on this docs-only change I found no regression to trust boundaries, authorization or data exposure. The remaining question is for source passes covering the benchmark code: that the concurrency mode keeps the prefix cache disabled and sends no network or coordinator traffic.
